note: Allegany County NY does not zone unincorporated land itself; its towns and villages (e.g. Wellsville, Alfred, Friendship) zone locally. The county GIS/planning pages publish zoning only as static PDF maps (2003 survey, 2013 draft, 2005 Wellsville map) and link to no ArcGIS REST service, WFS or downloadable zoning polygons. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for zoning in the county and in Wellsville returned no queryable district layer. Parcel data is only commercial (uslandgrid, Rockford Map), not official.
